workable_spec.summary: Fix security policy bypass when target file is open in the IDE
workable_spec.architectural_insights: The Gemini CLI policy engine evaluates tool invocation arguments against rules such as `argsPattern`. When a file is active or open in the IDE context, the active file state or IDE diffing handlers interact with tool invocation pathways. The policy check in `checkPolicy` and `PolicyEngine.check` must be guaranteed to run and correctly match file path arguments regardless of whether the file is active or open in the IDE context.
proposed_changes: Verify that tool calls for file modification (`replace`, `write_file`) always undergo policy checks prior to reaching IDE diffing or file-writing logic.
Normalize file paths in tool call arguments during policy evaluation so `argsPattern` rules match reliably against relative and absolute path variants.
Add unit tests to `policy-engine.test.ts` and `edit.test.ts` to verify that `deny` policy rules for `replace` and `write_file` are enforced when files are open in the IDE.

github_metadata.title: Policy is bypassed if the file is opened in the IDE
